Compass Community Health (CCH) uses the financial benefit generated through its participation in the 340B Drug Pricing Program to support and expand access to comprehensive, affordable healthcare for the patients and communities it serves. These savings allow CCH to stretch limited resources, offset the cost of caring for uninsured and underinsured patients, support the Sliding Fee Discount Program, and sustain services for which reimbursement may not cover the full cost of care.
The 340B savings also contribute to the continued operation of Compass Pharmacy and CCH’s efforts to improve access to affordable medications and promote medication adherence. In addition, these resources help support primary care, women’s health, mental health, pediatric occupational and speech therapy, care coordination, outreach, patient education, clinical staffing, technology, supplies, and other services necessary to meet identified community needs.
By reinvesting the benefit of the 340B Program into health center operations and patient services, CCH reduces financial and access barriers, maintains and expands essential services, and provides more comprehensive care to medically underserved individuals.
